runText: {name} is a program. Would you like to start it, or just have a look at it?
fmLabel: Make it the default file manager
fmTipWindows: A double click on a folder in Explorer, Win+E and folders from other programs then open here. So that this is quick, CannonCommander waits in the notification area after you close it. Switched off, Explorer gets everything back.
fmTipLinux: Folders from other programs then open here, also Show in folder from the browser. So that this is quick, CannonCommander waits in the tray after you close it. Switched off, your previous file manager gets everything back.
fmNowOn: Lovely, your folders now open in CannonCommander
fmNowOff: Your folders open as before again
styleTip: Sets the keys and how the mouse selects. You can change each of them on its own afterwards, the keys with F1.
clickSelectTip: A click selects a file, a frame drawn with the mouse selects several, and the selection follows the arrow keys. Off, it is as in a commander: a click only moves the cursor, and Ctrl, Shift or Insert mark.
styleTitle: As in Explorer or like a commander?
styleText: Lovely to have you here! How would you like to use CannonCommander? You can change it any time in the settings under General.
explorerHow: A click selects a file, a frame drawn with the mouse selects several. F5 refreshes, Backspace goes back and Alt+D jumps to the path bar.
commanderHow: A click moves the cursor, and Ctrl, Shift or Insert mark. F5 copies and F6 moves to the other panel.
